Equinix Docs MCP Server v0.1.0

MCP tools exposed by equinix-docs-mcp-server, described as OpenRPC methods. Each method is an MCP tool: call it with the JSON-RPC request `tools/call` and params `{"name": "<method>", "arguments": {<params>}}`. API tools are generated from the Equinix OpenAPI specs and named `<family>_<operationId>`; by default the server lists only the docs tools plus `search_tools`/`call_tool`, and the API tools documented here are reached through them.

Generated from openrpc.json (OpenRPC 1.3.2).

access_createAccessPolicy Allows a user to create a new access policy.

Allows a user to create a new access policy. The access policy is created in the project identified by the `projectId`. An access policy contains that same data as a permission set but also includes the `grants` field for indicating what principals can use the access policy. Access to this operation is controlled by the project being accessed. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/createAccessPolicy`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

subtractSubtract_46ea2c39 Entries in the `subtract` field are not included in the results from this permission object.

access_createPermissionSet Allows users to define a permission set object which can then be used as a reusable building block when defining

Allows users to define a permission set object which can then be used as a reusable building block when defining access policies. The permission set is created in the project identified by the `projectId`. A permission set is conceptually a set of action/resource tuples. The set is computed based on the `permissions`, `intersect`, and `subtract` fields. Each of those fields is a unioned composite and are then combined by taking the `permissions` tuples, intersected with the `intersect` tuples, and then from that the `subtract` tuples are removed. Access to this operation is controlled by the project being accessed. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/createPermissionSet`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-permission-set

tagsobject yesAdditional user-controlled data about this resource.
permissionsPermissions_0c73f7d1 yesA set of permissions, each of which may be an inline permission, a permission set reference, or a foreign access policy reference.
permissionSetIdstring yesUniquely identifies a PermissionSet within a project.
descriptionstring
intersectIntersect Entries must appear in both the `intersect` field and the `permissions` to be in the results from this permission object.
subtractSubtract_46ea2c39 Entries in the `subtract` field are not included in the results from this permission object.
allowBadRefs"additional" Indicates that the permission set should be created even if it includes invalid references to permission objects.

      "example": "project:abc-123"
    },

access_deleteAccessPolicy Allows a user to delete an access policy identified by either the `accessPolicyId` or the `accessPolicyErn`

Allows a user to delete an access policy identified by either the `accessPolicyId` or the `accessPolicyErn` parameter. The access policy is deleted from the project identified by the `accessPolicyErn` if provided, else in the project that owns the access policy being used to invoke the operation. The project must be disabled and not have any grants in order for it to be deleted. Access to this operation is controlled by the access policy being accessed. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/deleteAccessPolicy`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

access_disableAccessPolicy Allows a user to disable an access policy identified by either the `accessPolicyId` or the `accessPolicyErn`

Allows a user to disable an access policy identified by either the `accessPolicyId` or the `accessPolicyErn` parameter. The access policy is updated in the project identified by the `accessPolicyErn` if provided, else in the project that owns the access policy being used to invoke the operation. Disabling an access policy means that it is not available for users to assume via token exchange and current tokens with this access policy as their scope will eventually lose access. Access to this operation is controlled by the access policy being accessed. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/disableAccessPolicy`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-access-policy

ParamTypeRequiredDescription

access_getEffectivePermissions Returns a unified representation of the caller's permissions for a given service,

Returns a unified representation of the caller's permissions for a given service, based on the supplied access token. A user in possession of a valid access token is always authorized to perform this operation. There is no corresponding action id, because permission to perform the operation does not depend on the role assignments or access policy of the caller. Permissions are always returned in the context of a specific project. When a project id is not supplied, permissions are returned for the project containing access policy in the access token's scope. When the access token is not associated with an access policy, a project id must be specified. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/getEffectivePermissions`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-misc

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
projectIdstring yesGlobally unique identifier of a project.
serviceIdstring yesFully qualified, universally unique id of a service. Starts with the NamespaceId. Formatted like "service:&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;service&gt;".

}

access_listAccessPolicies Allows a user to page through all of the access policies within a project.

Allows a user to page through all of the access policies within a project. The project is identified by `projectId`. Access to this operation is controlled by the project being accessed. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/listAccessPolicies`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-access-policy

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
projectIdstring yesGlobally unique identifier of a project.
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "projectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^project:[0-9a-zA-Z](?![^:]*-$)(?![^:]*--)[0-9a-zA-Z-]{0,35}$",
      "description": "Globally unique identifier of a project.",
      "example": "project:abc-123"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "projectId"
  ]
}

access_listActionSets Allows a user to page through the action sets defined for a given `serviceId`.

Allows a user to page through the action sets defined for a given `serviceId`. This allows users to discover what action sets are available to be used when defining access policies. Access to this is operation is controlled by the project specified by `projectId`. The results are filtered according to the service mask of that same project. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/listActionSets`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-misc

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
projectIdstring yesGlobally unique identifier of a project.
serviceIdstring yesFully qualified, universally unique id of a service. Starts with the NamespaceId. Formatted like "service:&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;service&gt;".
pageTokenstring When paging through results, the PageToken is an opaque indicator that identifies a page.
pageSizeinteger When paging through results, this is an integer indicating the maximum number of results to return. Note, it is possible for fewer results to be returned even when the end of the result set has not been reached.
projectErnAccessPolicyId_542bc819 Equinix resource name, a universally unique identifier for a resource across all clouds, regions, and services. Formatted as "ern:&lt;cloudId&gt;:&lt;serviceId&gt;:&lt;regionId&gt;:&lt;projectId&gt;:&lt;resourceType&gt;:&lt;resourceId&gt;".
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "projectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^project:[0-9a-zA-Z](?![^:]*-$)(?![^:]*--)[0-9a-zA-Z-]{0,35}$",
      "description": "Globally unique identifier of a project.",
      "example": "project:abc-123"
    },
    "serviceId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^service:[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,49}/[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,49}$",
      "description": "Fully qualified, universally unique id of a service. Starts with the NamespaceId. Formatted like\n  \"service:&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;service&gt;\".",
      "example": "service:equinix/sts"
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 4096,
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "When paging through results, the PageToken is an opaque indicator that identifies a page.",
      "example": "eyJwYWdlIjoyfQ=="
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "maximum": 1000.0,
      "minimum": 1.0,
      "description": "When paging through results, this is an integer indicating the maximum number of results to return. Note, it is\n  possible for fewer results to be returned even when the end of the result set has not been reached.",
      "example": 20
    },
    "projectErn": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AccessPolicyId_542bc819"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "projectId",
    "serviceId"
  ]
}

access_listActions Allows a user to page through the actions defined for a given `serviceId`.

Allows a user to page through the actions defined for a given `serviceId`. This allows users to discover what actions are available to be used when defining access policies. Access to this is operation is controlled by the project specified by `projectId`. The results are filtered according to the service mask of that same project. The results will include actions from all of the aspects which are accessible based on the service mask. When the service mask does not allow any access to the service an exception is thrown. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/listActions`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-misc

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
projectIdstring yesGlobally unique identifier of a project.
serviceIdstring yesFully qualified, universally unique id of a service. Starts with the NamespaceId. Formatted like "service:&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;service&gt;".
pageTokenstring When paging through results, the PageToken is an opaque indicator that identifies a page.
pageSizeinteger When paging through results, this is an integer indicating the maximum number of results to return. Note, it is possible for fewer results to be returned even when the end of the result set has not been reached.
projectErnAccessPolicyId_542bc819 Equinix resource name, a universally unique identifier for a resource across all clouds, regions, and services. Formatted as "ern:&lt;cloudId&gt;:&lt;serviceId&gt;:&lt;regionId&gt;:&lt;projectId&gt;:&lt;resourceType&gt;:&lt;resourceId&gt;".

      "pattern": "^service:[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,49}/[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,49}$",
      "description": "Fully qualified, universally unique id of a service. Starts with the NamespaceId. Formatted like\n  \"service:&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;service&gt;\".",

The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/listGrants`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-access-policy

pageTokenstring When paging through results, the PageToken is an opaque indicator that identifies a page.
pageSizeinteger When paging through results, this is an integer indicating the maximum number of results to return. Note, it is possible for fewer results to be returned even when the end of the result set has not been reached.

access_listResourceTypes Allows a user to page through the resource types defined for a given `serviceId`.

Allows a user to page through the resource types defined for a given `serviceId`. This allows users to discover what resource types are available to be used when defining access policies. access_listRoles Get a page of all the Roles visible.

For an Access Policy token, all Custom Roles usable by the project are visible (if given, otherwise the project that owns the Access Policy). For a Role Assignment token, all Custom Roles usable by the token's Organization are visible and the project args are unsupported. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/listRoles`. access_updateAccessPolicy Allows a user to update the definition of an access policy identified by the `accessPolicyId`.

Allows a user to update the definition of an access policy identified by the `accessPolicyId`. The access policy is updated in the project identified by the `projectId`. It is possible that some of the objects referenced by the updated access policy no longer exist or are no longer accessible. Such cases will produce an error unless the `allowBadRefs` parameter is set to "existing". Setting this parameter allows users to update access policies even if something unrelated to their update has changed since the access policy was created. Using this flag allows urgent access policy changes to be made without requiring the caller to address issues outside of their immediate concrent. Access to this operation is controlled by the access policy being accessed. The auth token's access policy must allow `action:use/updateAccessPolicy`. Part of the Equinix Access Service API family (access). Manage access policies and role assignments.

Tags: access identity permissions v1-access-policy

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
projectIdProjectId_23abb2eb yesGlobally unique identifier of a project. Callers may URL encode this value. Use `*` here to indicate that accessPolicyId is an ERN.
accessPolicyIdAccessPolicyId_80cae0a0 yesUniquely identifies an access policy within a project. Callers may URL encode this value. When passing an ERN, callers *must* URL encode this value.
tagsobject yesAdditional user-controlled data about this resource.
permissionsPermissions_0c73f7d1 yesA set of permissions, each of which may be an inline permission, a permission set reference, or a foreign access policy reference.
lastRevLastRev yesAn opaque string that represents the expected revision of a given resource. This is provided when a resource is updated so that if a concurrent update has occurred since the resource was read, then the collision will be detected.
descriptionstring
intersectIntersect Entries must appear in both the `intersect` field and the `permissions` to be in the results from this permission object.
subtractSubtract_46ea2c39 Entries in the `subtract` field are not included in the results from this permission object.
allowBadRefs"existing" | "additional" Indicates that the access policy should be updated even if it includes invalid references to permission objects. Setting to "existing" will allow existing invalid references to remain, but will complain if new invalid references are introduced. Setting to "additional" will allow both existing and new invalid references to be accepted without complaint.

accesstoken

accesstoken_GetOAuth2AccessToken This API handles authentication and authorization of the API developer.

This API handles authentication and authorization of the API developer. It returns an access_token which would be valid for 60 minutes. The user account will get locked after 5 successive invalid attempts. Part of the Equinix Equinix API Authentication API family (accesstoken). Obtain OAuth2 API access tokens (legacy Equinix API authentication).

Tags: accesstoken OAuth2 Token auth identity

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
client_idstring yesAPI Consumer Key available under "My Apps" in developer portal
client_secretstring yesAPI Consumer secret available under "My Apps" in developer portal
user_namestring Deprecated - The Equinix username used to access portals
user_passwordstring Deprecated - The Equinix user password used to access portals
grant_typestring The OAuth2 grant type used for authorization. Supported values are "password" & "client_credentials". user_name and password is not considered in case this value is "client_credentials". If the grant_type is not passed, by default it would consider "password" type in which user_name and password is required. Note that the password grant type is deprecated. Recommended to use grant_type of 'client_credentials' instead.
password_encodingstring For enhanced security, you may encrypt the password value while requesting for an access_token. Currently only "md5-b64" hashing is supported. Any other value would treat password value as raw string
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "API Consumer Key available under \"My Apps\" in developer portal"
    },
    "client_secret": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "API Consumer secret available under \"My Apps\" in developer portal"
    },
    "user_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Deprecated - The Equinix username used to access portals"
    },
    "user_password": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Deprecated - The Equinix user password used to access portals"
    },
    "grant_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The OAuth2 grant type used for authorization. Supported values are \"password\" & \"client_credentials\". user_name and password is not considered in case this value is \"client_credentials\". If the grant_type is not passed, by default it would consider \"password\" type in which user_name and password is required. Note that the password grant type is deprecated. Recommended to use grant_type of 'client_credentials' instead."
    },
    "password_encoding": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "For enhanced security, you may encrypt the password value while requesting for an access_token. Currently only \"md5-b64\" hashing is supported. Any other value would treat password value as raw string",
      "default": "none"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "client_id",
    "client_secret"
  ]
}
Result: Accesstoken_GetOAuth2AccessTokenResult 
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Accesstoken_GetOAuth2AccessTokenResult"
}

assets_getAssetById The Get assets by Id API returns all details for a specific asset from its identification number.

The Get assets by Id API returns all details for a specific asset from its identification number. The authorization token and content-type are the only headers that are passed to this API and a response is received based on the values passed. Part of the Equinix Install Bases Asset API family (assets). Assets are all the products and equipment belonging to your organization that are installed in Equinix's IBXs. These assets can be viewed by users with the appropriate permissions. Assets can be searched by a filter criterion, or the details of an individual asset can be looked up by its asset ID.

assets_searchAssets The POST assets API returns all assets for a specific asset from search form.

The POST assets API returns all assets for a specific asset from search form. The authorization token and content-type are the only headers that are passed to this API and a response is received based on the values passed. Part of the Equinix Install Bases Asset API family (assets). Assets are all the products and equipment belonging to your organization that are installed in Equinix's IBXs. These assets can be viewed by users with the appropriate permissions. Assets can be searched by a filter criterion, or the details of an individual asset can be looked up by its asset ID.

Tags: assets Assets colocation

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
Authorization yesSpecify the Access token with prefix 'Bearer '.
sorts"SERIAL_NUMBER" | "ORDER_NUMBER" | "PRODUCT_TYPE" | "PRODUCT_NAME" | "CAGE" | "IBX" | …[] Sort fields
source"LEGACY_CAGE" | "LEGACY_CABINET" | "LEGACY_PATCH_PANEL" | "LEGACY_SALES_ORDER" | "BILLING_AGREEMENT" | "CAGE" | …[] "q" parameter will be searched in these fields, by default search will performed on all fields
qstring To support add a keyword, free text search on source fields. Min 3 character for efficient search results.
exactMatchboolean flag determines the q should be Exact match or partial match, By default flag is false
offset The start index from which the list is created.
limit Number of entries in response.
filterobject assets search filter.

          "-INSTALLED_DATE",
          "-ASSET_NUMBER"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Sort fields "
    },
    "source": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "LEGACY_CAGE",
          "LEGACY_CABINET",
          "LEGACY_PATCH_PANEL",

          "BILLING_AGREEMENT",

          "SERIAL_NUMBER",

      "description": "flag determines the q should be Exact match or partial match, By default flag is false"

      "description": "The start index from which the list is created."
    },
    "limit": {
      "description": "Number of entries in response."

    "filter": {
      "type": "object",

              "EQUINIX_CONNECT"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "List of product types to be filtered."
        },
        "dateRange": {
          "required": [
            "fromDate",

          "type": "object",

              "type": "string",

            },
            "toDate": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "End date to filter the installed date.",
              "format": "date-time"
            }
          },
          "description": "Date range filter. The installed date should be within this data range."
        }

  "required": [

billing_Retrieve_billing_details This method retrieves detailed invoice or credit memo information based on date range, account number or transactions I…

This method retrieves detailed invoice or credit memo information based on date range, account number or transactions ID for a user with billing viewing permission. Part of the Equinix Equinix Billing API family (billing). The Billing API allows users to view summarized and detailed versions of invoices and credit memos. Users can filter the responses based on date range, account numbers, and transaction IDs. The user's permission is applied to retrieve the invoice summary, and invoice details will be from the past….

crossconnects_Order_cross_connects This method creates an order for single or multiple standard cross connects at locations where a user has cross connect…

This method creates an order for single or multiple standard cross connects at locations where a user has cross connects ordering permission. Part of the Equinix Cross Connect API family (crossconnects). Order and manage physical cross connects between colocation deployments.

Tags: crossconnects Cross Connects colocation interconnection

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
customerReferenceIdstring Customer Reference Identifier / External Reference Identifier
attachmentsAttachmentsItem_7dcbc88d[] File(s) attached to the Cross Connect
descriptionstring Description of Cross Connect
expediteDateTimestring Expedite orders are delivered within the next 2 - 24 hours. Value must be in ISO-8601 UTC timezone format.
detailsobject[] Cross connections details
purchaseOrderPurchaseOrder_d179fb3a Purchase Order
contactsContacts_4a0177e7
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "customerReferenceId": {
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Customer Reference Identifier / External Reference Identifier",
      "example": "048837d6-4cd8-401f-ba41-a4ac015c3f3e"
    },
    "attachments": {
      "maxItems": 5,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AttachmentsItem_7dcbc88d"
      },
      "description": "File(s) attached to the Cross Connect"
    },
    "description": {
      "maxLength": 4000,
      "minLength": 0,
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Description of Cross Connect",
      "example": "Any additonal details the technician may need to complete your request"
    },
    "expediteDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Expedite orders are delivered within the next 2 - 24 hours. Value must be in ISO-8601 UTC timezone format.",
      "format": "date-time",
      "example": "2020-05-22T19:23:51.000Z"
    },
    "details": {
      "maxItems": 10,
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "required": [
          "aSide",
          "zSide"
        ],
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "aSide": {
            "required": [
              "patchPanel",
              "connectionService",
              "mediaType",
              "protocolType",
              "connectorType"
            ],
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "patchPanel": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/PatchPanel_06ef935c"
              },
              "connectionService": {
                "enum": [
                  "COAX",
                  "MP4_CABLE",
                  "MULTI_MODE_FIBER",
                  "POTS",
                  "SINGLE_MODE_FIBER",
                  "UTP"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the available connection service.",
                "example": "SINGLE_MODE_FIBER"
              },
              "mediaType": {
                "enum": [
                  "COAX",
                  "MP4_CABLE",
                  "50_MICRON_MULTI_MODE_FIBER",
                  "50_MICRON_MULTI_MODE_FIBER_OM2",
                  "50_MICRON_MULTI_MODE_FIBER_OM3",
                  "50_MICRON_MULTI_MODE_FIBER_OM4",
                  "62.5_MICRON_MULTI_MODE_FIBER",
                  "62.5_MICRON_MULTI_MODE_FIBER_OM1",
                  "ABAM",
                  "CAT3",
                  "CAT5E",
                  "CAT6",
                  "CAT6A",
                  "OS1",
                  "SINGLE_MODE_FIBER"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Name of media type.",
                "example": "SINGLE_MODE_FIBER"
              },
              "protocolType": {
                "enum": [
                  "ANTENNA",
                  "DS-3",
                  "E1",
                  "E3",
                  "ETHERNET",
                  "FAST_ETHERNET",
                  "GIGABIT_ETHERNET",
                  "POTS",
                  "T1",
                  "FIBRE_CHANNEL",
                  "10_GIG_ETHERNET",
                  "100_GIG_ETHERNET",
                  "40_GIG_ETHERNET",
                  "DARK_FIBER",
                  "DWDM",
                  "56K",
                  "ISDN",
                  "OC-12",
                  "OC-192",
                  "OC-3",
                  "OC-48",
                  "STM-1",
                  "STM-16",
                  "STM-4",
                  "STM-64",
                  "NA"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Name of protocol type.",
                "example": "FAST_ETHERNET"
              },
              "connectorType": {
                "enum": [
                  "BNC",
                  "LC",
                  "FC",
                  "SC",
                  "ST",
                  "WIRE_WRAP",
                  "RJ45",
                  "E2000",
                  "RJ11"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Name of connector type.",
                "example": "LC"
              },
              "mediaConverterRequired": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "When `false`, Equinix will not proceed with cross connect installation that requires media conversion"
              },
              "ifcCircuitCount": {
                "maximum": 48.0,
                "minimum": 1.0,
                "type": "integer",
                "description": "Use this field to request an intra-facility cable IFC with this order. Note that there might be a delay in fulfilment of Cross Connect as it is pending intra facility cabling",
                "example": 4
              },
              "patchEquipment": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/PatchEquipment"
              }
            },
            "description": "A-Side source patch panel to establish connection to another customer. Connections Service , Media Type and Protocol Type is mandatory to establish new connection. "
          },
          "zSide": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "notificationEmail": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Z-Side customer will be notified when cross connect is complete via specified email address",
                "example": "firstname.lastname@company.com"
              }
            },
            "description": "Z-Side can be an existing or a new customer without patch panel. For an existing customer, only `patchPanel` and `connectorType` are required. For a new customer or patch panel, `providerName`, `ibx`, and `loaAttachmentId` are required",
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "required": [
                  "loaAttachmentId",
                  "ibx",
                  "providerName"
                ],
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "loaAttachmentId": {
                    "maxLength": 36,
                    "minLength": 36,
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Attachment ID of Letter of Authorization (LOA). Refer to Attachment API to upload documents via API.",
                    "example": "8d0bef9c-cca9-11ea-87d0-0242ac130003"
                  },
                  "ibx": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "IBX location code."
                  },
                  "providerName": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Account name of service provider.",
                    "example": "Carigan Communications  "
                  }
                }
              },
              {
                "required": [
                  "patchPanel",
                  "connectorType"
                ],
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "connectorType": {
                    "enum": [
                      "BNC",
                      "LC",
                      "FC",
                      "SC",
                      "ST",
                      "WIRE_WRAP",
                      "RJ45",
                      "E2000",
                      "RJ11"
                    ],
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Name of connector type.",
                    "example": "LC"
                  },
                  "patchPanel": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/PatchPanel_06ef935c"
                  },
                  "circuitId": {
                    "minLength": 1,
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Customer or carrier circuit ID cable reference number for verification purposes."
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          },
          "diverseConnections": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "type": {
                "enum": [
                  "NEW",
                  "EXISTING"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Redundant connection with existing connections or new connections",
                "default": "EXISTING"
              },
              "serialNumber": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The serial number of Cross Connect is expecting when Diversified connection required from a previously provisioned connection"
              },
              "aSide": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "patchPanel": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/PatchPanel_06ef935c"
                  },

                    "enum": [

                      "SC",
                      "ST",
                      "WIRE_WRAP",
                      "RJ45",
                      "E2000",
                      "RJ11"
                    ],
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Name of connector type.",
                    "example": "LC"
                  },
                  "mediaConverterRequired": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "ASide media Converter Required",
                    "default": false
                  },
                  "ifcCircuitCount": {
                    "maximum": 48.0,
                    "minimum": 1.0,
                    "type": "integer",
                    "description": "Use this field to request an intra-facility cable IFC with this order. Note that there might be a delay in fulfilment of Cross Connect as it is pending intra facility cabling",

                  "patchEquipment": {

                  }

                "type": "object",

                  },

                      "ST",
                      "WIRE_WRAP",
                      "RJ45",
                      "E2000",
                      "RJ11"
                    ],
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Name of connector type.",
                    "example": "LC"
                  },
                  "circuitId": {
                    "minLength": 1,
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Unique Circut ID for future reference",
                    "example": "100931"
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            "description": "Diversified cross connect or redundant cross connect for the availability. If its a new redundant connection, A-Side and Z-Side is mandatory. If it is existing connection, Cross Connect serial number and type is mandatory."

crossconnects_Place_cross_connect_deinstallation_order This API allows user to initiate a cross connect deinstallation request.

This API allows user to initiate a cross connect deinstallation request. Cross connect asset will be removed according to order placed. Part of the Equinix Cross Connect API family (crossconnects). Order and manage physical cross connects between colocation deployments.

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
customerReferenceIdstring Customer Reference Identifier / External Reference Identifier
purchaseOrderPurchaseOrder_d179fb3a Purchase Order
contactsContacts_4a0177e7

descriptionstring Description of deinstallation
detailsobject[] layer #1 connections details

Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "customerReferenceId": {
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Customer Reference Identifier / External Reference Identifier"
    },
    "purchaseOrder": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/PurchaseOrder_d179fb3a"
    },
    "contacts": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Contacts_4a0177e7"
    },
    "attachments": {
      "maxItems": 5,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AttachmentsItem_7dcbc88d"
      },
      "description": "File(s) attached to the layer #1 connections"
    },
    "description": {
      "maxLength": 4000,
      "minLength": 0,
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Description of deinstallation",
      "example": "Any additonal details the technician may need to complete your request"
    },
    "details": {
      "maxItems": 10,
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "required": [
          "assetId"
        ],
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "assetId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Asset ID of the cross connect you wish to de-install",
            "example": "4-1234567890"
          },
          "proceedWithLiveTraffic": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "description": "When `true`, Equinix will proceed with deinstallation request despite detecting live traffic.",

          },
          "patchEquipment": {
            "required": [
              "cabinetId",
              "details",
              "port"
            ],
            "type": "object",

                "type": "string",
                "description": "The cabinet to remove patch cable from",

              },
              "details": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Provide additional information to facilitate patch equipment removal",

              },
              "port": {
                "minimum": 1.0,
                "type": "number",
                "description": "Device port number to be removed",
                "example": 12
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "description": " layer #1 connections details"
    },
    "removalDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Equinix will aim to terminate this Cross Connect at this date subjected to operation availability.",
      "format": "date",
      "example": "2022-11-23"
    }
  },
  "required": []
}

  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CallToolResult"
}

      "description": "Digital LOA expiration date.",

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "routerId": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Router UUID",
      "format": "uuid",
      "example": "557400f8-d360-11e9-bb65-2a2ae2dbcce4"
    },

      "enum": [
        "PING_COMMAND",
        "TRACEROUTE_COMMAND"

      "example": "PING_COMMAND"
    },
    "project": {
      "required": [
        "projectId"
      ],
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "projectId": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Subscriber-assigned project ID",
          "example": "44f4c4f8-2f39-494e-838c-d8e640591be5"
        }
      }
    },
    "request": {
      "required": [
        "destination",
        "sourceConnection"
      ],
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Fabric Cloud Router Ping or Traceroute Command Destination",

          "required": [

          "type": "object",

              "description": "Connection UUID",

            }
          },
          "description": "Connection object for Cloud Router Command"
        },
        "timeout": {
          "type": "integer",
          "description": "Timeout in seconds for Fabric Cloud Router Command:\n  - For `PING_COMMAND`: Packet timeout duration. The default value is 5.\n  - For `TRACEROUTE_COMMAND`: Probe timeout duration.\n    The default value is 2 and it is not configurable.\n",
          "example": 2
        },
        "dataBytes": {
          "maximum": 9000.0,
          "minimum": 16.0,
          "type": "integer",
          "description": "Ping Command DataBytes. \nThis field is only applicable for commands of type `PING_COMMAND`.\n",

          "example": 100
        },

          "description": "Number of probes for Fabric Cloud Router Traceroute Command.\nThis field is only applicable for commands of type `TRACEROUTE_COMMAND` and is not configurable.\n",

        },
        "hopsMax": {
          "maximum": 30.0,
          "type": "integer",
          "description": "Maximum number of hops for the traceroute command.\nThis field is only applicable for commands of type `TRACEROUTE_COMMAND`.\n",

          "example": 20
        }
      },
      "description": "Fabric Cloud Router Command Request"

      "type": "string",
      "description": "Customer-provided Cloud Router Command name"
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Customer-provided Cloud Router Command description"
    }

  "required": [

    "type",
    "project",
    "request"
  ]
}

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
type"OC" yesOC - Optical Connect Type
bandwidthinteger yesConnection bandwidth Mbps. <br> Available bandwidths depend on the IBX pair. <br> 1000 - 1 Gbps. <br> 10000 - 10 Gbps. <br> 100000 - 100 Gbps. <br>
connectionDestinationTypeConnectionDestinationType yesWhere the Z-side terminates. <br> COLO - your own colocation space at another Equinix IBX. <br> BMMR - a Building Meet-Me Room. <br> REMOTE - another customer's colocation space at another Equinix IBX. <br> BMMR and REMOTE require a Letter of Authorization on the Z-side.
pathTypePathType_63f97b0d yesLevel of resilience for the connection. <br> UNPROTECTED - a single fiber path with no node redundancy. <br> PROTECTED - two diverse fiber paths between single nodes at each IBX. <br> DUAL_DIVERSE - two diverse fiber paths terminating on redundant nodes at both IBXs.
aSideASide_4d7848a9 yesA-Side configuration. Always a patch panel port from your cage.
zSideZSide_a38d6db4 yesZ-Side configuration. <br> For COLO, specify the destination patch panel and ports. <br> For BMMR and REMOTE, specify the location and Letter of Authorization.
redundancyRedundancy_e8c4a2d1 Optical Connect redundancy configuration. <br> Required only for DUAL_DIVERSE connection.
orderOrder_95704d9c Ordering and billing reference details for this connection.
accountAccount_0dedb04b
notificationsNotifications_a30c8a98 Contacts to notify about connection configuration and status changes
bmmrType"EQUINIX" | "SELF" BMMR infrastructure ownership type. <br> EQUINIX - Equinix-operated. <br> SELF - customer-operated. <br> Required only when connectionDestinationType is BMMR.

lookup_Get_Locations_by_permission_code This method retrieves all the user’s IBX locations, accounts, cages and cabinets information according to their orderin…

This method retrieves all the user’s IBX locations, accounts, cages and cabinets information according to their ordering permission. This includes A-side and Z-side location information for a cross connect order. Part of the Equinix Lookup API family (lookup). Based on a user's permission, a user may view their locations, provider and patch panel in their organization. These locations can be filtered by permission code, account number, cage and cabinet details to get both A Side and Z side IBX locations and patch panel available ports to place an order.

Tags: lookup Lookup colocation

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
permissionCode"CROSS_CONNECT" | "WORK_VISIT" | "SHIPMENTS" yesList of Permission code to be filtered
ibxsstring[] List of IBXs to be filtered
providerAccountNumberstring The service provider's account number (Z-side) linked to their cage. Mandatory when used together with `aSideIbx`. This is only applicable when permissionCode is `CROSS_CONNECT`
aSideIbxstring A-Side IBX details to fetch the (Z-side). This is only applicable when permissionCode is `CROSS_CONNECT`
connectionServicestring Type of connection service to fetch the Z-side details. This is only applicable when permissionCode is `CROSS_CONNECT` and is required when searching for zSide details.
detailsboolean When `true`, API response returns cage, cabinet and account details
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "permissionCode": {
      "enum": [
        "CROSS_CONNECT",
        "WORK_VISIT",
        "SHIPMENTS"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "description": "List of Permission code to be filtered"
    },
    "ibxs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "List of IBXs to be filtered"
    },
    "providerAccountNumber": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The service provider's account number (Z-side) linked to their cage. Mandatory when used together with `aSideIbx`. This is only applicable when permissionCode is `CROSS_CONNECT`"
    },
    "aSideIbx": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A-Side IBX details to fetch the (Z-side). This is only applicable when permissionCode is `CROSS_CONNECT`"
    },
    "connectionService": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Type of connection service to fetch the Z-side details. This is only applicable when permissionCode is `CROSS_CONNECT` and is required when searching for zSide details."
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "description": "When `true`, API response returns cage, cabinet and account details"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "permissionCode"
  ]
}

metal_createDevice Creates a new device and provisions it in the specified location.

Creates a new device and provisions it in the specified location. Device type-specific options are accepted. For example, `baremetal` devices accept `operating_system`, `hostname`, and `plan`. These parameters may not be accepted for other device types. The default device type is `baremetal`. Part of the Equinix Equinix Metal API family (metal). Equinix Metal bare metal servers: provision and manage on-demand dedicated servers, IPs, and VLANs.

Tags: metal Devices bare-metal compute

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
idstring yesProject UUID
metroMetro_0d579229 yesMetro code or ID of where the device should be provisioned in, or it can be instructed to create the device in the best available metro with `{ "metro": "any" }`. The special metro value of any means anywhere, any metro. When any is chosen in the request, the metro location is picked per our scheduling algorithms that favor the following factors: hardware reservation location (if requesting reserved hardware), ip reservations, spot instances, etc. The any keyword *does not* optimize for cost, this means that usage costs (instance, transfer, other features dependent on location) will vary. Please check metro value in response to see where the device was created. Additionally it is possible to set a prioritized location selection. For example `{ "metro": ["m3", "m2", "any"] }` can be used to prioritize `m3` and then `m2` before accepting `any` metro. If none of the metros provided have availability for the requested device the request will fail. Either metro or facility must be provided.
operating_systemstring yesThe slug of the operating system to provision. Check the Equinix Metal operating system documentation for rules that may be imposed per operating system, including restrictions on IP address options and device plans.
planstring yesThe slug of the device plan to provision.
includestring[] Nested attributes to include. Included objects will return their full attributes. Attribute names can be dotted (up to 3 levels) to included deeply nested objects.
excludestring[] Nested attributes to exclude. Excluded objects will return only the href attribute. Attribute names can be dotted (up to 3 levels) to exclude deeply nested objects.
always_pxeboolean When true, devices with a `custom_ipxe` OS will always boot to iPXE. The default setting of false ensures that iPXE will be used on only the first boot.
billing_cycle"hourly" | "daily" | "monthly" | "yearly" The billing cycle of the device.
customdataobject Customdata is an arbitrary JSON value that can be accessed via the metadata service.
descriptionstring Any description of the device or how it will be used. This may be used to inform other API consumers with project access.
featuresFeatures The features attribute allows you to optionally specify what features your server should have. In the API shorthand syntax, all features listed are `required`: ``` { "features": ["tpm"] } ``` Alternatively, if you do not require a certain feature, but would prefer to be assigned a server with that feature if there are any available, you may specify that feature with a `preferred` value. The request will not fail if we have no servers with that feature in our inventory. The API offers an alternative syntax for mixing preferred and required features: ``` { "features": { "tpm": "required", "raid": "preferred" } } ``` The request will only fail if there are no available servers matching the required `tpm` criteria.
hardware_reservation_idHardware_reservation_id The Hardware Reservation UUID to provision. Alternatively, `next-available` can be specified to select from any of the available hardware reservations. An error will be returned if the requested reservation option is not available. See [Reserved Hardware](https://docs.equinix.com/metal/deploy/reserved/) for more details.
hostnamestring The hostname to use within the operating system. The same hostname may be used on multiple devices within a project.
ip_addressesIp_addresses_502dcc25 The `ip_addresses attribute will allow you to specify the addresses you want created with your device. The default value configures public IPv4, public IPv6, and private IPv4. Private IPv4 address is required. When specifying `ip_addresses`, one of the array items must enable private IPv4. Some operating systems require public IPv4 address. In those cases you will receive an error message if public IPv4 is not enabled. For example, to only configure your server with a private IPv4 address, you can send `{ "ip_addresses": [{ "address_family": 4, "public": false }] }`. It is possible to request a subnet size larger than a `/30` by assigning addresses using the UUID(s) of ip_reservations in your project. For example, `{ "ip_addresses": [..., {"address_family": 4, "public": true, "ip_reservations": ["uuid1", "uuid2"]}] }` To access a server without public IPs, you can use our Out-of-Band console access (SOS) or proxy through another server in the project with public IPs enabled.
ipxe_script_urlstring When set, the device will chainload an iPXE Script at boot fetched from the supplied URL. See [Custom iPXE](https://docs.equinix.com/metal/operating-systems/custom-ipxe/) for more details.
lockedboolean Whether the device should be locked, preventing accidental deletion.
network_frozenboolean If true, this instance can not be converted to a different network type.
no_ssh_keysboolean Overrides default behaviour of attaching all of the organization members ssh keys and project ssh keys to device if no specific keys specified
private_ipv4_subnet_sizeinteger Deprecated. Use ip_addresses. Subnet range for addresses allocated to this device.
project_ssh_keysProject_ssh_keys A list of UUIDs identifying the device parent project that should be authorized to access this device (typically via /root/.ssh/authorized_keys). These keys will also appear in the device metadata. If no SSH keys are specified (`user_ssh_keys`, `project_ssh_keys`, and `ssh_keys` are all empty lists or omitted), all parent project keys, parent project members keys and organization members keys will be included. This behaviour can be changed with 'no_ssh_keys' option to omit any SSH key being added.
public_ipv4_subnet_sizeinteger Deprecated. Use ip_addresses. Subnet range for addresses allocated to this device. Your project must have addresses available for a non-default request.
spot_instanceboolean DEPRECATED. Spot Market has been discontinued.
spot_price_maxnumber DEPRECATED. Spot Market has been discontinued.
ssh_keysSsh_keys_35c99064 A list of new or existing project ssh_keys that should be authorized to access this device (typically via /root/.ssh/authorized_keys). These keys will also appear in the device metadata. These keys are added in addition to any keys defined by `project_ssh_keys` and `user_ssh_keys`.
storageStorage_748ca222
tagsstring[]
termination_timeTermination_time_36cd0666 When the device will be terminated. If you don't supply timezone info, the timestamp is assumed to be in UTC. This is commonly set in advance for ephemeral spot market instances but this field may also be set with on-demand and reservation instances to automatically delete the resource at a given time. The termination time can also be used to release a hardware reservation instance at a given time, keeping the reservation open for other uses. On a spot market device, the termination time will be set automatically when outbid.
user_ssh_keysUser_ssh_keys A list of UUIDs identifying the users that should be authorized to access this device (typically via /root/.ssh/authorized_keys). These keys will also appear in the device metadata. The users must be members of the project or organization. If no SSH keys are specified (`user_ssh_keys`, `project_ssh_keys`, and `ssh_keys` are all empty lists or omitted), all parent project keys, parent project members keys and organization members keys will be included. This behaviour can be changed with 'no_ssh_keys' option to omit any SSH key being added.
userdataUserdata The userdata presented in the metadata service for this device. Userdata is fetched and interpreted by the operating system installed on the device. Acceptable formats are determined by the operating system, with the exception of a special iPXE enabling syntax which is handled before the operating system starts. See [Server User Data](https://docs.equinix.com/metal/server-metadata/user-data/) and [Provisioning with Custom iPXE](https://docs.equinix.com/metal/operating-systems/custom-ipxe/#provisioning-with-custom-ipxe) for more details.

{
  "type": "object",

metal_createSpotMarketRequest Creates a new spot market request.

Creates a new spot market request. Type-specific options (such as operating_system for baremetal devices) should be included in the main data structure alongside hostname and plan. The features attribute allows you to optionally specify what features your server should have. For example, if you require a server with a TPM chip, you may specify `{ "features": { "tpm": "required" } }` (or `{ "features": ["tpm"] }` in shorthand). The request will fail if there are no available servers matching your criteria. Alternatively, if you do not require a certain feature, but would prefer to be assigned a server with that feature if there are any available, you may specify that feature with a preferred value (see the example request below). The request will not fail if we have no servers with that feature in our inventory. Part of the Equinix Equinix Metal API family (metal). Equinix Metal bare metal servers: provision and manage on-demand dedicated servers, IPs, and VLANs.

idstring yesProject UUID

bgp_dynamic_neighbors_export_route_mapboolean Toggle to export the VRF route-map to the dynamic bgp neighbors
bgp_dynamic_neighbors_bfd_enabledboolean Toggle BFD on dynamic bgp neighbors sessions
descriptionstring
ip_rangesstring[] A list of CIDR network addresses. Like ["10.0.0.0/16", "2001:d78::/59"]. IPv4 blocks must be between /8 and /29 in size. IPv6 blocks must be between /59 and /64. local_asninteger

      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Toggle to enable the dynamic bgp neighbors feature on the VRF"

    "bgp_dynamic_neighbors_export_route_map": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Toggle to export the VRF route-map to the dynamic bgp neighbors"
    },
    "bgp_dynamic_neighbors_bfd_enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Toggle BFD on dynamic bgp neighbors sessions"
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ip_ranges": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {

      "description": "A list of CIDR network addresses. Like [\"10.0.0.0/16\", \"2001:d78::/59\"]. IPv4 blocks must be between /8 and /29 in size. IPv6 blocks must be between /59 and /64. A VRF\\'s IP ranges must be defined in order to create VRF IP Reservations, which can then be used for Metal Gateways or Virtual Circuits."

metal_deleteIPAddress This call can be used to un-assign an IP assignment or delete

This call can be used to un-assign an IP assignment or delete an IP reservation. Un-assign an IP address record. Use the assignment UUID you get after attaching the IP. This will remove the relationship between an IP and the device or metal gateway and will make the IP address available to be assigned to another device, once the IP has been un-configured from the network. Delete an IP reservation. Use the reservation UUID you get after adding the IP to the project. This will permanently delete the IP block reservation from the project. Part of the Equinix Equinix Metal API family (metal). Equinix Metal bare metal servers: provision and manage on-demand dedicated servers, IPs, and VLANs.

metal_performAction Performs an action for the given device.

Performs an action for the given device. Possible actions include: power_on, power_off, reboot, reinstall, and rescue (reboot the device into rescue OS.) Part of the Equinix Equinix Metal API family (metal). Equinix Metal bare metal servers: provision and manage on-demand dedicated servers, IPs, and VLANs.

Tags: metal Devices bare-metal compute

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
idstring yesDevice UUID
type"power_on" | "power_off" | "reboot" | "rescue" | "reinstall" yesAction to perform. See Device.actions for possible actions.
force_deleteboolean May be required to perform actions under certain conditions
deprovision_fastboolean When type is `reinstall`, enabling fast deprovisioning will bypass full disk wiping.
preserve_databoolean When type is `reinstall`, preserve the existing data on all disks except the operating-system disk.
operating_systemstring When type is `reinstall`, use this `operating_system` (defaults to the current `operating system`)
ipxe_script_urlstring When type is `reinstall`, use this `ipxe_script_url` (`operating_system` must be `custom_ipxe`, defaults to the current `ipxe_script_url`)
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "description": "Device UUID"
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "power_on",
        "power_off",
        "reboot",
        "rescue",
        "reinstall"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Action to perform. See Device.actions for possible actions."
    },
    "force_delete": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "May be required to perform actions under certain conditions"
    },
    "deprovision_fast": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "When type is `reinstall`, enabling fast deprovisioning will bypass full disk wiping."
    },
    "preserve_data": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "When type is `reinstall`, preserve the existing data on all disks except the operating-system disk."
    },
    "operating_system": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "When type is `reinstall`, use this `operating_system` (defaults to the current `operating system`)",
      "example": "ubuntu_22_04"
    },
    "ipxe_script_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "When type is `reinstall`, use this `ipxe_script_url` (`operating_system` must be `custom_ipxe`, defaults to the current `ipxe_script_url`)"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id",
    "type"
  ]
}

metal_requestIPReservation Request more IP space for a project in order to have additional IP addresses to assign to devices.

Request more IP space for a project in order to have additional IP addresses to assign to devices. If the request is within the max quota, an IP reservation will be created. If the project will exceed its IP quota, a request will be submitted for review, and will return an IP Reservation with a `state` of `pending`. You can automatically have the request fail with HTTP status 422 instead of triggering the review process by providing the `fail_on_approval_required` parameter set to `true` in the request. Part of the Equinix Equinix Metal API family (metal). Equinix Metal bare metal servers: provision and manage on-demand dedicated servers, IPs, and VLANs.

metal_updateVrf Updates the VRF.

Updates the VRF. Part of the Equinix Equinix Metal API family (metal). Equinix Metal bare metal servers: provision and manage on-demand dedicated servers, IPs, and VLANs.

Tags: metal VRFs bare-metal compute

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
idstring yesVRF UUID
includestring[] Nested attributes to include. Included objects will return their full attributes. Attribute names can be dotted (up to 3 levels) to included deeply nested objects.
excludestring[] Nested attributes to exclude. Excluded objects will return only the href attribute. Attribute names can be dotted (up to 3 levels) to exclude deeply nested objects.
bgp_dynamic_neighbors_enabledboolean Toggle to enable the dynamic bgp neighbors feature on the VRF
bgp_dynamic_neighbors_export_route_mapboolean Toggle to export the VRF route-map to the dynamic bgp neighbors
bgp_dynamic_neighbors_bfd_enabledboolean Toggle BFD on dynamic bgp neighbors sessions
descriptionstring
ip_rangesstring[] A list of CIDR network addresses. Like ["10.0.0.0/16", "2001:d78::/59"]. IPv4 blocks must be between /8 and /29 in size. IPv6 blocks must be between /59 and /64. A VRF\'s IP ranges must be defined in order to create VRF IP Reservations, which can then be used for Metal Gateways or Virtual Circuits. Adding a new CIDR address to the list will result in the creation of a new IP Range for this VRF. Removal of an existing CIDR address from the list will result in the deletion of an existing IP Range for this VRF. Deleting an IP Range will result in the deletion of any VRF IP Reservations contained within the IP Range, as well as the VRF IP Reservation\'s associated Metal Gateways or Virtual Circuits. If you do not wish to add or remove IP Ranges, either include the full existing list of IP Ranges in the update request, or do not specify the `ip_ranges` field in the update request. Specifying a value of `[]` will remove all existing IP Ranges from the VRF.
local_asninteger The new `local_asn` value for the VRF. This field cannot be updated when there are active Interconnection Virtual Circuits associated to the VRF, or if any of the VLANs of the VRF's metal gateway has been assigned on an instance.
namestring
tagsstring[]
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "description": "VRF UUID"
    },

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Nested attributes to include. Included objects will return their full\nattributes. Attribute names can be dotted (up to 3 levels) to included deeply\nnested objects."
    },
    "exclude": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Nested attributes to exclude. Excluded objects will return only the href\nattribute. Attribute names can be dotted (up to 3 levels) to exclude deeply\nnested objects."
    },
    "bgp_dynamic_neighbors_enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Toggle to enable the dynamic bgp neighbors feature on the VRF"
    },
    "bgp_dynamic_neighbors_export_route_map": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Toggle to export the VRF route-map to the dynamic bgp neighbors"
    },
    "bgp_dynamic_neighbors_bfd_enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Toggle BFD on dynamic bgp neighbors sessions"
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ip_ranges": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "A list of CIDR network addresses. Like [\"10.0.0.0/16\", \"2001:d78::/59\"]. IPv4 blocks must be between /8 and /29 in size. IPv6 blocks must be between /59 and /64. A VRF\\'s IP ranges must be defined in order to create VRF IP Reservations, which can then be used for Metal Gateways or Virtual Circuits. Adding a new CIDR address to the list will result in the creation of a new IP Range for this VRF. Removal of an existing CIDR address from the list will result in the deletion of an existing IP Range for this VRF. Deleting an IP Range will result in the deletion of any VRF IP Reservations contained within the IP Range, as well as the VRF IP Reservation\\'s associated Metal Gateways or Virtual Circuits. If you do not wish to add or remove IP Ranges, either include the full existing list of IP Ranges in the update request, or do not specify the `ip_ranges` field in the update request. Specifying a value of `[]` will remove all existing IP Ranges from the VRF."
    },
    "local_asn": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "The new `local_asn` value for the VRF. This field cannot be updated when there are active Interconnection Virtual Circuits associated to the VRF, or if any of the VLANs of the VRF's metal gateway has been assigned on an instance.",
      "format": "int32"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tags": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [

  ]
}

licenseFileIdstring This is the Id of the uploaded license file. For a CSR1KV SDWAN device, upload your license file by calling Upload License File. In the response, you'll get a fileId that you can enter here as licenseFileId. This field may be required for some vendors.

      "type": "string",
      "description": "This is the Id of the uploaded license file. For a CSR1KV SDWAN device, upload your license file by calling Upload License File. In the response, you'll get a fileId that you can enter here as licenseFileId. This field may be required for some vendors.",
      "example": "329a0bcd-0b2f-4bc5-b875-b506aa4b9730"

          "type": "string",

        },
        "adminPassword": {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AdminPassword"
        },
        "activationKey": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Available on VMware Orchestration Portal",
          "example": "GJUK-JM2X-59BJ-2TDJ"
        },
        "provisioningKey": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Mandatory for Zscaler devices",
          "example": "provisioningKeysample"
        },
        "panoramaIpAddress": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "IP address of the Panorama controller. Provide this value to have Panorama integration. Relevant for Palo Alto Self-Configured devices with Internet Access",
          "example": "1.1.1.1"

          "example": "123456"

      },
      "description": "RMA vendor configuration"
    },
    "userPublicKey": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/UserPublicKey_6fc2aa31"
    }
  },

network-edge_createVirtualDevice Creates a virtual device.

Creates a virtual device. Sub-customers cannot choose the subscription licensing option. To create a device, you must accept the Order Terms. Call Get Order Terms to review the details. If you are creating an Equinix-Configured device, read your vendor's terms by calling Get Vendor Terms. Part of the Equinix Equinix Network Edge API family (network-edge). Network Edge (NE) is a platform for deploying and running virtual network services and appliances such as routers, load balancers, and firewalls on generic hardware. This eliminates the need for dedicated hardware, upfront capital expenditure (CapEx), and colocation space. Use these REST APIs to….

Tags: network-edge Virtual-Device network virtual-devices

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
versionstring yesVersion.
deviceTypeCodeDeviceTypeCode yesDevice type code (e.g., C8000V)
agreeOrderTermsboolean yesTo create a device, you must accept the order terms. Call Get Order Terms to review the details. If you are creating an Equinix-Configured device, read your vendor's terms by calling Get Vendor Terms.
licenseMode"SUB" | "BYOL" yesLicense type. One of SUB (Subscription) or BYOL (Bring Your Own License)
metroCodestring yesMetro code
virtualDeviceNamestring yesVirtual device name for identification. This should be minimum 3 and maximum 50 characters long.
notificationsstring[] yesEmail addresses for notification. We need a minimum of 1 and no more than 5 email addresses.
deviceManagementType"SELF-CONFIGURED" | "EQUINIX-CONFIGURED" yesWhether the device is SELF-CONFIGURED or EQUINIX-CONFIGURED
coreinteger yesThe desired number of cores.
draftboolean Whether to save this as a draft.
draftUuidstring The unique ID of the draft to be promoted to a device.
accountNumberstring Account number. Either an account number or accountReferenceId is required.
accountReferenceIdstring AccountReferenceId. This is a temporary ID that can be used to create a device when the account status is still pending, not active. Either an account number or accountReferenceId is required.
projectIdstring Customer project Id. Check your projectId under Resource Management on Equinix Portal. You should have access to a project to see or create assets under it. Equinix will assign a projectId if you do not provide one.
hostNamePrefixHostNamePrefix Host name prefix for identification. Only a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and hyphen(-) are allowed. It should start with a letter and end with a letter or digit. The length should be between 2-30 characters. Exceptions - FTDv 2-14 characters; Aruba 2-24 characters.
licenseCategorystring This field will be deprecated in the future.
licenseFileIdLicenseFileId For Juniper devices you need to provide a licenseFileId if you want to BYOL (Bring Your Own License). You get a licenseFileId when you upload a license file by calling license upload API (Upload a license file before creating a virtual device). For Cisco devices, you do not need to provide a licenseFileId at the time of device creation. Once the device is provisioned, you can get the deviceSerialNo by calling Get virtual device {uuid} API. With the deviceSerialNo you can generate a license file on Cisco site. Afterward, you can upload the license file by calling license upload API (Upload a license file after creating a virtual device).
licenseTokenstring In case you want to BYOL (Bring Your Own License) for a Palo Alto device, you must provide a license token. This field must have 8 alphanumeric characters.
day0TextFileIdDay0TextFileId Some devices require a day0TextFileId. Upload your license file by calling Upload File API. You'll get a fileUuid in the response. You can enter the value in the day0TextFileId field of the create payload to create a virtual device. Check the payloads of individual devices (provided as Postman Scripts on our API doc site) for details.
termlengthstring Term length in months.
packageCodestring Software package code
sshUsersSshUsers_922add19 An array of sshUsernames and passwords
throughputinteger Numeric throughput. For Cisco8KV self-configured devices, you can choose either numeric or tier throughput options.
throughputUnitstring Throughput unit.
tierinteger Tier throughput. Relevant for Cisco8KV devices. For Cisco8KV self-configured devices, you can choose either numeric or tier throughput options. Possible values - 0, 1, 2, 3. Default - 2
orderingContactstring Username of the ordering contact.
aclDetailsAclDetails_90ec39be An array of ACLs
additionalBandwidthinteger Secondary additional bandwidth to be configured (in Mbps for HA). Default bandwidth provided is 15 Mbps.
interfaceCountinteger The desired number of interfaces.
siteIdstring Site ID.
systemIpAddressstring System IP address.
vendorConfigVendorConfig_9949fa91 Vendor-specific configuration
userPublicKeyUserPublicKey_6fc2aa31 An object with public key details.
ipType"STATIC" This field is deprecated. The ipType value always defaults to STATIC.
sshInterfaceIdstring You may specify any available interface on the device as the sshInterfaceId. This field is only applicable to self-configured devices.
smartLicenseUrlstring License URL. This field is only relevant for Ciso ASAv devices.
diverseFromDeviceUuidstring Unique ID of an existing device. Use this field to let Equinix know if you want your new device to be in a different location from any existing virtual device. This field is only meaningful for single devices.
clusterDetailsClusterDetails Cluster configuration details
primaryDeviceUuidstring This field is mandatory if you are using this API to add a secondary device to an existing primary device.
connectivity"INTERNET-ACCESS" | "PRIVATE" | "INTERNET-ACCESS-WITH-PRVT-MGMT" Specifies the connectivity on the device. You can have INTERNET-ACCESS, PRIVATE, or INTERNET-ACCESS-WITH-PRVT-MGMT. Private devices don't have ACLs or bandwidth.
channelPartnerstring The name of the channel partner.
cloudInitFileIdstring The Id of a previously uploaded license or cloud_init file.
purchaseOrderNumberstring Purchase Order information will be included in your order confirmation email.
orderReferencestring Enter a short name/number to identify this order on the invoice.
secondarySecondary_20f9e0a2 Request to create a secondary HA device
Params schema
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Version.",
      "example": "16.09.03"
    },
    "deviceTypeCode": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DeviceTypeCode"
    },

      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "To create a device, you must accept the order terms. Call Get Order Terms to review the details. If you are creating an Equinix-Configured device, read your vendor's terms by calling Get Vendor Terms.",

    },
    "licenseMode": {
      "enum": [
        "SUB",
        "BYOL"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "description": "License type. One of SUB (Subscription) or BYOL (Bring Your Own License)",
      "example": "SUB"
    },
    "metroCode": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Metro code",
      "example": "SV"
    },

This API is for updating a virtual device draft <br/>and does not support device update as of now. Part of the Equinix Equinix Network Edge API family (network-edge). This eliminates the need for dedicated hardware, upfront capital expenditure (CapEx), and colocation space. Use these REST APIs to….

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
draftboolean yesdraft
uuidstring yesUnique Id of a Virtual Device
versionstring yesVersion.
deviceTypeCodeDeviceTypeCode yesDevice type code (e.g., C8000V)
agreeOrderTermsboolean yesTo create a device, you must accept the order terms. Call Get Order Terms to review the details. If you are creating an Equinix-Configured device, read your vendor's terms by calling Get Vendor Terms.
licenseMode"SUB" | "BYOL" yesLicense type. One of SUB (Subscription) or BYOL (Bring Your Own License)
metroCodestring yesMetro code
virtualDeviceNamestring yesVirtual device name for identification. This should be minimum 3 and maximum 50 characters long.
notificationsstring[] yesEmail addresses for notification. We need a minimum of 1 and no more than 5 email addresses.
deviceManagementType"SELF-CONFIGURED" | "EQUINIX-CONFIGURED" yesWhether the device is SELF-CONFIGURED or EQUINIX-CONFIGURED
coreinteger yesThe desired number of cores.
accountNumberstring Account number. Either an account number or accountReferenceId is required.
accountReferenceIdstring AccountReferenceId. This is a temporary ID that can be used to create a device when the account status is still pending, not active. Either an account number or accountReferenceId is required.
projectIdstring Customer project Id. Check your projectId under Resource Management on Equinix Portal. You should have access to a project to see or create assets under it. Equinix will assign a projectId if you do not provide one.
hostNamePrefixHostNamePrefix Host name prefix for identification. Only a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and hyphen(-) are allowed. It should start with a letter and end with a letter or digit. The length should be between 2-30 characters. Exceptions - FTDv 2-14 characters; Aruba 2-24 characters.
licenseCategorystring This field will be deprecated in the future.
licenseFileIdLicenseFileId For Juniper devices you need to provide a licenseFileId if you want to BYOL (Bring Your Own License). You get a licenseFileId when you upload a license file by calling license upload API (Upload a license file before creating a virtual device). For Cisco devices, you do not need to provide a licenseFileId at the time of device creation. Once the device is provisioned, you can get the deviceSerialNo by calling Get virtual device {uuid} API. With the deviceSerialNo you can generate a license file on Cisco site. Afterward, you can upload the license file by calling license upload API (Upload a license file after creating a virtual device).
licenseTokenstring In case you want to BYOL (Bring Your Own License) for a Palo Alto device, you must provide a license token. This field must have 8 alphanumeric characters.
day0TextFileIdDay0TextFileId Some devices require a day0TextFileId. Upload your license file by calling Upload File API. You'll get a fileUuid in the response. You can enter the value in the day0TextFileId field of the create payload to create a virtual device. Check the payloads of individual devices (provided as Postman Scripts on our API doc site) for details.
termlengthstring Term length in months.
packageCodestring Software package code
sshUsersSshUsers_922add19 An array of sshUsernames and passwords
throughputinteger Numeric throughput. For Cisco8KV self-configured devices, you can choose either numeric or tier throughput options.
throughputUnitstring Throughput unit.
tierinteger Tier throughput. Relevant for Cisco8KV devices. For Cisco8KV self-configured devices, you can choose either numeric or tier throughput options. Possible values - 0, 1, 2, 3. Default - 2
orderingContactstring Username of the ordering contact.
aclDetailsAclDetails_90ec39be An array of ACLs
additionalBandwidthinteger Secondary additional bandwidth to be configured (in Mbps for HA). Default bandwidth provided is 15 Mbps.
interfaceCountinteger The desired number of interfaces.
siteIdstring Site ID.
systemIpAddressstring System IP address.
vendorConfigVendorConfig_9949fa91 Vendor-specific configuration
userPublicKeyUserPublicKey_6fc2aa31 An object with public key details.
ipType"STATIC" This field is deprecated. The ipType value always defaults to STATIC.
sshInterfaceIdstring You may specify any available interface on the device as the sshInterfaceId. This field is only applicable to self-configured devices.
smartLicenseUrlstring License URL. This field is only relevant for Ciso ASAv devices.
diverseFromDeviceUuidstring Unique ID of an existing device. Use this field to let Equinix know if you want your new device to be in a different location from any existing virtual device. This field is only meaningful for single devices.
clusterDetailsClusterDetails Cluster configuration details
primaryDeviceUuidstring This field is mandatory if you are using this API to add a secondary device to an existing primary device.
connectivity"INTERNET-ACCESS" | "PRIVATE" | "INTERNET-ACCESS-WITH-PRVT-MGMT" Specifies the connectivity on the device. You can have INTERNET-ACCESS, PRIVATE, or INTERNET-ACCESS-WITH-PRVT-MGMT. Private devices don't have ACLs or bandwidth.
channelPartnerstring The name of the channel partner.
cloudInitFileIdstring The Id of a previously uploaded license or cloud_init file.
purchaseOrderNumberstring Purchase Order information will be included in your order confirmation email.
orderReferencestring Enter a short name/number to identify this order on the invoice.
secondarySecondary_20f9e0a2 Request to create a secondary HA device
